question:
Select the word that best completes the given sentence. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

Varun, the chef, _______ up a delicious meal in just 30 minutes.
solution:
The correct answer is '**whipped**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**whipped up**" is a colloquial expression meaning to quickly prepare or assemble a meal.
 
• Varun, the chef, uses his culinary skills to quickly prepare a delicious meal.
 
• The other options: "**hit**," "**kept**," and "**held**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Varun, the chef, whipped__ up a delicious meal in just 30 minutes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Hit (मार)**: means to strike or come into sudden contact with something.
 
• **Kept (रखा)**: is the past tense of keep, meaning to retain possession of something.
 
• **Held (पकड़ा)**: is the past tense of hold, meaning to grasp or carry.
